description_for_human: Ask the assurance advisors or request a governed TPRM report.
description_for_model: Use askAdvisor for security/GRC/regulatory questions (seconds-scale answers with sources). Use requestReport to start a governed report pipeline (returns a runId; the file lands in SharePoint after human approval). Use getReportStatus to check a runId.

functions.name: askAdvisor
functions.description: Ask one assurance advisory agent a question and return its sourced answer.

functions.name: requestReport
functions.description: Start a governed report pipeline for a supplier/service; returns runId.

functions.name: getReportStatus
functions.description: Return the status and SharePoint link of a requested report.
